notes: UTRAnnotator's two rows on genome-wide ClinVar read an adjusted F1 of 1.000000000 with no row left and a raw F1 below v0.6.0's re-scoring against Ensembl VEP 116.3 (GRCh37: 0.955927155 against 0.955930106, 985,884 shared tuples against 985,888; GRCh38: 0.965674743 against 0.965679016, 2,914,642 against 2,914,652) by rows of documented differences alone: the tuples each class alone sets aside, read by a score without it, are 12 on GRCh37 and 44 on GRCh38 for `utrannotator_lost_stop_written_before_stop_codon`, 2 and 2 for `utrannotator_frameshift_at_stop_boundary`, and 204 and 432 for `utrannotator_gained_start_remade_in_place`.

Seven rows on genome-wide ClinVar read an adjusted F1 of 1.000000000 with no row left and a raw F1 below v0.6.0's re-scoring because vep-rs writes more tuples that the documented difference `plugin_value_follows_stop_codon_term_pair` sets aside, the shared tuples standing at or above v0.6.0's: AlphaMissense (16 more tuples on GRCh37, 18 on GRCh38), REVEL (10 and 1), NMD (22 and 67) and LoFTEE on GRCh38 (1,085).

The two SpliceAI rows scored on synthetic fixtures (`GRCh37-plugin-spliceai-fixture` and `GRCh38-plugin-spliceai-fixture`) read an adjusted F1 of 1.000000000 with no row left and a raw F1 below their rows of v0.6.0's re-scoring (0.828009828 against 0.928977273 and 0.787272727 against 0.935861684), every tuple of the fall set aside by the documented difference `spliceai_multi_entry_cell` (840 tuples on GRCh37, 936 on GRCh38): each of the two synthetic corpora gained six made-up records in v1.0.0.

On the cells of the whole-genome population datasets, 118 rows, each one plugin on one cell, read an adjusted F1 of 1.000000000 with no row left and a raw F1 below v0.6.0's re-scoring by the same documented differences: 74 rows of UTRAnnotator (17 on GRCh37, 57 on GRCh38) under the documented UTRAnnotator differences, and 44 rows under `plugin_value_follows_stop_codon_term_pair` (AlphaMissense 7, Downstream 12, NMD 8, REVEL 17), in each of which vep-rs writes more tuples and the shared tuples equal v0.6.0's.

The cells of the plugins of the family `plugins_grch38` on the dataset `gnomad_v4.1_genomes` (GRCh38) were scored with the plugin scorer of the commit that adds this record, because its comparison rule of the documented difference `utrannotator_lost_stop_written_before_stop_codon` takes the values of one record that the rule of this record's source commit leaves; every other table was scored with the scorer of the source commit.
